result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but the wide roadway creates long crossing distances. The environment is dominated by vehicle traffic with limited protection or dedicated signaling for pedestrians visible in the image.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible to guide safe crossing times relative to traffic light cycles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk near a commercial land use. Safety is compromised by degraded pavement surfaces and sightline obstructions caused by overgrown landscaping at the corner.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: The roadway surface within the intersection and crosswalk area is heavily cracked and patched, creating potential trip hazards.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large, dense bushes at the corner of the property block the view between drivers turning right and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the commercial property near the traffic light

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve predictability.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, hazard-free walking and driving surface.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove the large bushes at the corner to improve visibility between all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a sidewalk and a signalized intersection, but suffers from significantly faded crosswalk markings and poor pavement quality. The presence of large trees and parked vehicles near the intersection creates potential sightline obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are severely worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway near the grey SUV

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and patched, which can create uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large trees and parked vehicles near the corner may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and traffic calming measures, which increases exposure to vehicular traffic at this signalized crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals which may not account for turning movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The open geometry of the intersection allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
